title: An email from the bank
body: Rahul's father received an email that appeared to come from his bank. It carried the bank's logo and said that his account would be blocked within 24 hours unless he updated his details. The email contained a link to a page that looked exactly like the bank's login page. He entered his username, password and the OTP he received on his phone. Later that day, money was withdrawn from his account. When Rahul looked at the email carefully, he noticed that the sender's address and the web address of the login page differed from the bank's real address by one letter.
